title.narrative: Improvement Allocation and Effectiveness of Social Spending Program
Programa de Mejora en la Asignacin y Efectividad del Gasto Social

description.narrative: El objetivo general de esta operacin es contribuir con la estrategia del Gobierno de Guatemala para incrementar el nivel de sus indicadores de nutricin, salud materno-infantil y progreso educativo, a travs de la promocin de mejoras en la ejecucin, calidad y equidad del gasto social.

The overall objective of this project is to contribute to the strategy of the Government of Guatemala to increase their level of nutrition indicators, maternal and child health and educational progress, by promoting improvements in performance, quality and equity social spending
